description: This file defines size computation functions and tables for jemalloc's internal size classes, including conversions between size, index, and usable size, as well as size alignment and lookup tables.

methods.name: sz_psz2ind
methods.description: Converts page size to size class index.

methods.name: sz_pind2sz_compute
methods.description: Computes size from size class index.

methods.name: sz_pind2sz_lookup
methods.description: Lookup size from size class index using table.

methods.name: sz_pind2sz
methods.description: Returns size from size class index.

methods.name: sz_psz2u
methods.description: Calculates usable size from page size.

methods.name: sz_size2index_compute
methods.description: Computes size class index from size.

methods.name: sz_size2index_lookup
methods.description: Lookup size class index from size using table.

methods.name: sz_size2index
methods.description: Returns size class index from size.

methods.name: sz_index2size_compute
methods.description: Computes size from size class index.

methods.name: sz_index2size_lookup
methods.description: Lookup size from size class index using table.

methods.name: sz_index2size
methods.description: Returns size from size class index.

methods.name: sz_sa2u
methods.description: Computes usable size from size and alignment.
